acceptance: clear on an absent bench exits 0 and says nothing to clear
fix: Design first. Exit 0 with nothing to clear, resolve scoped keys, and decide the class row.
summary: A review traced three failures: agy benches are keyed agy@scope, so clear agy misses them; a bench that a good launch already cleared gives exit 1; and project-root defaults to the working directory. The verb has no agentclass row, so an agent is denied by default.
title: evolve clihealth clear exits 1 on a scoped key, an absent bench or another directory
